title: lithocarpus bacgiangensis
intro: Lithocarpus bacgiangensis, commonly known as Bac Giang Lithocarpus, is a plant species in the beech family Fagaceae. It is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Lithocarpus bacgiangensis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as wound healing, anti-cancer, and anti-diabetic activities. Further research is needed to fully understand the therapeutic potential and health benefits of this plant species.
